defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It explicitly enumerates `product([1, 2, 3], repeat=n)`, giving exponential 3^n work and timing out on large instances.

Its visible approach stops at `Precompute connected components`; component decomposition alone does not solve 3-colorability or guarantee the required lexicographically smallest coloring, and its subsequent coloring logic was incorrect.
